This is a developer preview of Ziex; some features are still works in progress.
Update or install the Ziex CLI using the following scripts.

## Installation

##### Linux/macOS
```bash
curl -fsSL https://ziex.dev/install | bash -s -- v$VERSION
```
##### Windows
```powershell
powershell -c "iex ""& {$(irm https://ziex.dev/install.ps1)} -Version 'v$VERSION'"""
```
